# Culture Trip

> > Culture Trip is a cultural travel platform offering unique travel guides, experiences, and small-group tours to destinations worldwide.

Culture Trip specializes in curated cultural experiences and destination guides, focusing on authentic local experiences, historical sites, and off-the-beaten-path discoveries. The platform combines editorial travel content with bookable small-group adventure tours.

## Key Topics

- Cultural travel experiences
- Small-group tours
- Greece travel destinations
- Abandoned places and ghost towns
- Historical sites
- Guided cultural trips
- Adventure travel
- Destination discovery
- Greek villages and islands
- Spinalonga leper colony
- Crete and Irakleio
- Deserted villages
- Travel guides
- Authentic local experiences

## Platform & Services

- [Culture Trip: Unique Cultural Travel Guides & Experiences](https://front-desk.theculturetrip.com/): Homepage for Culture Trip cultural experiences & small-group travel tours

## Greece Travel Guides

- [Ghost Towns: A Guide To Abandoned Places In Greece](https://theculturetrip.com/europe/greece/articles/ghost-towns-a-guide-to-the-abandoned-places-in-greece): Guide to eerie ghost towns & abandoned sites in Greece incl. Ropoto & Kallio
